Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_15459",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo.c","function":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo2",
    "line":81,"var":"ancount","code":"ancount = DNS_HEADER_ANCOUNT(abuf);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"The answer count is read from the attacker-controlled DNS response header, determining how many A records will be parsed and stored."},
   {"step":2,"file":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo.c","function":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo2",
    "line":133,"var":"node","code":"node = ares__append_addrinfo_node(&nodes);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Each A record found creates a new addrinfo node appended to the linked list, one per answer record with no limit."},
   {"step":3,"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
    "line":82,"var":"naddrs","code":"++naddrs;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"naddrs counts total A records parsed from the response without checking against the caller-provided naddrttls limit."},
   {"step":4,"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
    "line":149,"var":"naddrs","code":"for (i = 0; i < naddrs; i++)",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"The loop iterates over all naddrs entries without bounding by *naddrttls, which is the size of the caller-provided addrttls array (5 elements)."},
   {"step":5,"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
    "line":156,"var":"addrttls[i]","code":"addrttls[i].ttl = next->ai_ttl;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Writing to addrttls[i] where i >= *naddrttls (5) causes a stack buffer overflow, writing past the end of the caller-provided array."}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo.c","function":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo2",
     "line":81,"operands":["ancount"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
     "line":149,"operands":["i","*naddrttls"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"i","right":"*naddrttls"}},
   "sink":{"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
     "line":156,"operands":["addrttls[i]","i"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"i","right":"*naddrttls"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo.c","function":"ares__parse_into_addrinfo2",
       "line":81,"operands":["ancount"]},
      "to":{"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
       "line":82,"operands":["naddrs"]},
      "type":"data","via":["ai.nodes linked list"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"naddrs","right":"ancount"}},
     {"from":{"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
       "line":149,"operands":["naddrs"]},
      "to":{"file":"ares_parse_a_reply.c","function":"ares_parse_a_reply",
       "line":156,"operands":["addrttls[i]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["i"],
      "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"i","right":"*naddrttls"}}
   ]
 }}
